scope: Retrospective replay on previously exposed public data. Old Block N confirmation drugs are new algorithm-test units, not untouched biological data. No LLM is called by these deterministic policies.
question: Does observation-dependent scientific planning improve terminal selective-cell-line decisions over a strong equal-budget batch design, and does transcriptional evidence contribute independently?

source_roles.reference_exclusion: Exclude the query and every reference drug with its exact annotated mechanism string; never add other query outcomes to references.

population: All algorithm-test drugs with a measured L1000 input, at least 16 finite buyable discovery-line outcomes and at least 50 finite terminal-line outcomes. No filtering by hidden killing activity.

geometry.line_split: Seeded permutation of all PRISM line identifiers; discovery first floor(n/2), terminal remainder. This source-only split is fixed before query outcomes are scored.
geometry.menu: 64 discovery lines with largest reference-only selective residual variance and at least 90% reference measurement availability; every arm has the same query-specific finite subset.
geometry.action: Reveal one recorded primary PRISM log-fold-change value for the query at a buyable discovery line.
geometry.terminal_action: Select the 10 terminal lines with smallest predicted selective residual, among lines with recorded primary outcomes. Terminal outcomes are never purchasable. Availability is public, values are hidden.
geometry.cost_unit: One line-compound measurement. Adaptive policies take up to 16 sequential turnarounds; batch policies one. A source-only policy purchases zero measurements. Existing 18-option L1000 input cost is shared and separately disclosed; cross-assay procurement costs are not inferred.

algorithm.world_model: Reference-profile library mixture with L1000 cosine prior and two integrated Gaussian nuisance coefficients (offset and reference-derived generic sensitivity). Primary observations update reference-particle weights by their marginal conditional likelihood; selective target means are weighted reference residuals. This is a probabilistic empirical surrogate, not a foundation-model forecast or mechanism-causal claim.
algorithm.planner: One-step Gaussian-moment approximation to expected improvement in terminal top-10 mean selective utility (knowledge gradient), recomputed after actual observations. Gaussian nodes are fixed quantiles. No candidate-specific hidden outcome enters action valuation.
algorithm.fixed_designs: A batch Gaussian knowledge-gradient design and a batch Gaussian integrated-variance design, using the same initial transcriptional mean and reference-only covariance. Both receive their selected measurements, then condition their prediction. A fixed-panel library-mixture model is also evaluated.
algorithm.strong_baseline_selection: Best calibration mean terminal selective utility among the fixed Gaussian designs and fixed library design; ties break lexicographically. The winner is frozen before algorithm-test execution.
algorithm.calibration_parameters: Choose tau by calibration source-only terminal utility; choose sigma by calibration fixed_library@16 terminal utility. No adaptive algorithm-test metrics are used for fitting.
algorithm.top10_precision_truth: Membership among the lowest 10% observed terminal selective residuals; descriptive rank endpoint, not a mechanistic or clinical hit definition.
algorithm.source_only: Mean of the 5 strongest positive-cosine transcriptional neighbors, matching the established simple transfer as closely as possible. Zero purchased observations.

statistics.primary: Seeded paired bootstrap 95% interval (4000 draws), paired sign-flip randomization (20000 draws), Holm correction across three primary contrasts. Primary PASS requires positive effect and corrected one-sided p <= 0.05.
statistics.dependence_sensitivity: Mechanism-string cluster bootstrap intervals. Exact annotation strings can be imperfect clusters; drug-level p-values are not independent biological replication.
statistics.secondary: Repeat terminal selection utility, precision and selective correlation on independently measured secondary-screen values at the dose nearest 2.5 uM, for compounds/lines with observations. Secondary values never feed selection or calibration. Report availability and missingness.
statistics.dual_core_gate: All three primary contrasts PASS; terminal precision does not decline by more than 0.02 versus the frozen best fixed; independent secondary adaptation effect has a positive interval lower bound. Otherwise report individual gains and failures without declaring dual-core superiority.

controls.feedback_shuffle: Pre-frozen per-drug permutation of candidate-line feedback values. Scoring truth is unchanged; the policy sees only purchased (misassigned) values.
controls.signature_shuffle: Pre-frozen permutation of query L1000 inputs, preserving viability and query identities; only source prior is changed.
leakage_checks: query-outcome poisoning leaves initial predictions/actions identical
terminal-outcome poisoning leaves full action trace identical
changing a purchased value can change subsequent actions
no duplicate purchase or terminal-line purchase
controls.outcome_shuffle: Paired outcome association-shuffle analysis is a diagnostic on frozen selected-line predictions, not a replacement test dataset.

reliability.calibration: For frozen policies, development campaigns calibrate a simultaneous absolute-error bound across all terminal predicted selective coordinates at budget 16 using the finite-sample conformal order statistic. Report test simultaneous coverage, width, and active-compound subgroup coverage, without adjusting the test threshold.
reliability.limit: Marginal exchangeability is an assumption; previously exposed data, exact mechanism exclusion and subgroup coverage limit biological certification. No LLM self-confidence is used.

efficiency: Set BLAS thread pools to one; retain action traces, per-arm wall time, costs, model-call count (zero actual API calls), and source-only acquisition cost. No optional advanced architecture is promoted merely by this replay.
